checked_sources: Independent replay: python3 /tmp/opencode/frozen_math_replay.py; the primitive() check directly builds the literal reduced Laplacian rooted at 000 and computes exact cofactors for q=2,3,4. The respective results are 4, 10331213040, and 57757330472898702105693539794944000.
correctness.rationale: Primitive four-words are exactly the arcs left after deleting abab, and the balanced positive degrees are q-1 at aba and q elsewhere. On the zero-sum space A^3 vanishes, so the unrestricted rooted cofactor is q^(q^3-4). The non-loop deletions are disjoint pairs of opposite arcs: with the oriented difference matrix F their correction is FF^T. The I, A and A^2 terms of the inverse act in the reduced determinant via F^TF=2I, F^TAF=-2I and F^TA^2F=B^TB, where B is the alphabet complete-graph incidence matrix. Its Gram eigenvalues q and 0 give the two stated factors, both positive for q>=2. A positive cofactor and balance give strong connectivity. Fixing one specified arc first gives a unique representative in each rotation class, so BEST has no additional start or length factor. The resulting formula covers q=2 without singular cases.
residual_risks: Finite cofactors corroborate the algebra but do not prove the all-q formula; no formal proof-assistant check was performed.
